links.comparator_used: Standard CDSS potential DDI alerts (usual care; control period, with five ICUs already using potential DDI alerts) versus an adapted CDSS alerting only for high-risk DDIs
links.outcome: Administered high-risk drug combinations per 1000 drug administrations per patient
links.effect: Mean 26·2 (SD 53·4) in intervention (n=5534) vs 35·6 (65·0) in control (n=4353); adjusted 12% decrease (95% CI 5-18%; p=0·0008)
links.quote: Tailoring potential DDI alerts to the ICU led to a 12% decrease (95% CI 5-18%; p=0·0008) in the number of administered high-risk drug combinations per 1000 drug administrations per patient, after adjusting for clustering and prognostic factors.

design_hint: alert threshold tailoring (restricting DDI alerts to high-risk combinations)
